hypothesis: Truthful daily-briefing metadata increases qualified organic landing engagement and downstream activation without harming page health or conversion.
control: Pre-change homepage title, description, and WebSite structured-data description.
variant: Homepage metadata describing the actual people-facing daily AI/technology briefing and context value.
allocation: Pre/post comparison; no concurrent traffic split.
cohort: Organic and direct homepage visitors; static landing pages are a qualitative comparison set.
primaryMetric: Qualified organic landing sessions and downstream landing_cta_clicked/user_signed_up rates.
exposureDefinition: Homepage request after deployment with the variant metadata present; no user assignment available.
successThreshold: Improved qualified landing engagement and downstream activation without material page-health or conversion regression; ranking claims require longer-horizon Search Console evidence.
rollbackCondition: Material engagement/conversion regression, metadata inaccuracies, broken structured data, or page-health regression.
deployment: live homepage verified HTTP 200; robots/sitemap/canonical verified; hosting SHA not exposed
blockers: Search Console is not configured or no local export is available
